thread:
Carlos (acme-corp): hey team — after last night's v15.2 rollout we started seeing a flood of function/tool call failures from production. lots of 400 schema_validation errors and retries, cost spiked. sample request/response below. can we escalate?

Maya (redwood-support): sorry about that @Carlos, escalating now. @Raj @Emma can you triage? I've marked this P1 and created a temporary incident channel.

Carlos (acme-corp): here's a minimal repro from our prod logs (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/invoke?model=v15.2 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "input": "get profile for user",
  "functions": [
    {"name": "lookup_user", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"user_id": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["user_id"]}}
  ],
  "temperature": 0.0
}

RESPONSE 400:
{
  "error": "tool invocation failed",
  "detail": "schema_validation: missing required property 'user_id' for tool lookup_user; tool selected = lookup-user-v2"
}
```
We saw thousands of these over 20 minutes and our integration retried, causing a billing bump.

Raj (eng-runtime): looking. quick context: the resolver update in v15.2's canary changed the tool-selection ranking for some prompts — it can prefer newer tool variants (lookup-user-v2) that have a different parameter schema. that explains the mismatch.

Emma (eng-ml): confirmed from the model traces — the model now signals the tool as "lookup-user-v2" (intent/selector token changed) for ~35% of our test prompts. older runtime tolerated some aliasing; in v15.2 the runtime started doing stricter schema-validation and no longer applies the legacy alias map by default. net result: model->tool name changed + stricter validation = 400s.

Maya (redwood-support): summary for customer: model v15.2 canary caused tool resolver to pick a variant whose schema doesn't match the function payload the model emits. that leads to schema_validation errors and retries.

Raj (eng-runtime): immediate mitigation options:
- roll back v15.2 canary (fastest)
- enable legacy-aliasing per-route (`X-Redwood-Tool-Aliasing: legacy`) so lookup-user-v2 will accept legacy `user_id` name for now
- pin your integration to model=v15.1 (customer side) until we have a safe migration path

Lisa (oncall): initiating rollback of v15.2 canary in us-east-1 now — starting stage-rollback job. @deploy-bot please record timeline and rollback reason.

deploy-bot: rollback job started for model v15.2 (canary) in region us-east-1. reason: tool-selection/schema-validation regressions reported by customers. job id: rb-20260317-01.

Raj (eng-runtime): I'll open a short-term patch to re-enable alias mapping for tool args while we update the resolver scoring and add explicit compatibility tests. planning: revert strict validation flag for canary traffic only, patch within the hour.

Emma (eng-ml): longer-term: we'll add a model-test that simulates function-calling across our tool catalog and detects tool-name drift or schema invariants before rollout. also adding a canary gate that runs synthetic integration checks.

Maya (redwood-support): @Carlos we rolled back the canary in your region — can you verify if errors drop? we're also crediting the spike as part of the incident review (billing team looped). :pray:

Carlos (acme-corp): confirming — error rate fell to normal within ~3 minutes after rollback. no more 400s in last 15 minutes. thanks for the quick action.

Lisa (oncall): incident wrapped for now. follow-ups: postmortem w/ timeline, billing credit decision, and change to canary gating. assigning to Raj/Emma for remediation action items.

Raj (eng-runtime): will post a short RCA and the mitigation PR (re-enable aliasing + add tests).

Emma (eng-ml): will add model-level regression tests and a canary synthetic suite.

Maya (redwood-support): thanks everyone — I'll keep Carlos updated on billing credits and the PM follow-up. closing thread once the RCA is posted.

Carlos (acme-corp): appreciated.
